guides.title: Getting started
guides.description: Install Sparkwire, add the stylesheet and render your first component in a couple of minutes. Works with Next.js, Vite and React Server Components.

guides.title: Theming
guides.description: Change colours, radius, type and motion with --spark-* CSS variables. Light, dark and system modes, and every token available in Tailwind.

guides.title: Energy dial
guides.description: Turn the Live Wire effects up, down or off with the energy dial, trigger sparks from your own code with useSpark(), and add haptics on mobile.

guides.title: Languages
guides.description: Built-in labels in English, Hindi, Gujarati and Tamil, Intl-formatted numbers and dates, other calendar systems, and right-to-left support.

guides.title: App-wide defaults
guides.description: Set default props and class names once for the whole app with SparkProvider, so every Button or Textfield starts the way you want.

guides.title: Render prop and variants
guides.description: Render Sparkwire behaviour on your own elements with the render prop, and add your own variants that stay type-checked.

guides.title: Tailwind
guides.description: Use Sparkwire with Tailwind CSS v3 or v4: every design token becomes a utility class, and it follows light and dark mode.

guides.title: Forms
guides.description: Use Sparkwire inputs in forms: native FormData, validation and error messages, and React Hook Form integration.

guides.title: Own the source
guides.description: Copy component source into your own repo with npx sparkwire add, or install through the shadcn CLI, and change anything you like.

guides.title: Headless hooks
guides.description: Bring your own markup and keep Sparkwire behaviour with headless hooks: useSwitch, useCheckbox, useSlider, useDatePicker and more.

guides.title: AI coding agents
guides.description: Give your AI coding assistant every Sparkwire prop and example through the MCP server and llms.txt, so it writes correct code first time.

guides.title: Packages
guides.description: What each Sparkwire package does: core components, styles, design tokens, icons, utilities, the CLI and the MCP server.

guides.title: Accessibility
guides.description: What Sparkwire handles for keyboard, screen reader and reduced-motion users, what you need to provide, and the known gaps.

guides.title: Translations
guides.description: Every built-in Sparkwire label in English, Hindi, Gujarati and Tamil. Native speakers: help us check and improve them.
